change_wifi_pwd_tips: Dear user, we kindly ask you to change the Wi-Fi password for your AlphaESS device as required by the EN303645 safety standard. Please create a strong password that is 8-16 characters long, excluding special characters like \, ", or :. It should include a mix of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols, and should not have repeated or consecutive characters.

platform_alert: We're currently dealing with a cloud platform data issue and our team is on it. Call wait times and ticket responses may take longer than usual today. We'd appreciate your patience — please give it a few hours and try again. If things still aren't right, give us a call or lodge a ticket and we'll get back to you.
wifi_hotspot_pwd_weak_tips: Dear user, your device WiFi hotspot password is weak. Please go to Device List, open the corresponding device, and change the password on the Device Hotspot page.
wifi_pwd_error: The password must include uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters (excluding spaces, counter slash \, and colon :). It should be at least 8 characters long (up to a maximum of 15 characters) and should not contain repeated or consecutive characters.
wifi_pwd_weak_tips: Dear user, the Wi-Fi password for your AlphaESS device is weak. Please go to "System Settings " - "Wi-Fi Configuration " to change your password.
